labour.loadingIncluded: Fully-loaded hourly cost INCLUDES: gross earnings for the occupation (national survey or ILOSTAT, the year shown), any statutory or customary annual bonus named, carried to 2026 by the wage growth shown, plus the employer's statutory social contributions, divided by the hours actually worked a year (paid leave and holidays fall on the hours worked)
labour.loadingNotIncluded: NOT included: employer-paid benefits that are not statutory (in the United States, health insurance and retirement plans — the US figure is a floor); a 3-shift premium beyond what the survey average holds; overtime; agency margins
labour.short: national / ILO occupation earnings + statutory employer contributions ÷ hours worked
